canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall F f bound, (forall n, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) mu) -> Integrable bound mu -> (forall n, norm (F n x) <= bound x almost everywhere) -> (F n x tends to f x almost everywhere) -> integral (F n) tends to integral f
canonical_formal_target.candidate_relationship: Pinned mathlib directly labels and implements Bochner and nonnegative lintegral dominated-convergence families. They are exact-topic formal interfaces, but the catalog does not select one variant or provide a source-to-Lean statement transport.
